tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List the campaigns (gamification programs) the current user can see. A campaign is a gamification program that groups quests (actions/rules) users complete to earn points. Optionally filter by a search term or by a space id (resolve a space with get_my_spaces).

term.description: Optional text to search campaigns by title.

space_id.description: Optional space technical id to only list campaigns of that space.

limit.description: Maximum number of campaigns to return (default 10, max 50).

tools.name: get_campaign
tools.title: Get a campaign
tools.description: Get a single campaign (gamification program) by its id. Resolve the campaign id with list_campaigns.

tools.name: list_quests
tools.title: List quests
tools.description: List the quests (gamification actions/rules) of a campaign, or across all accessible campaigns when no campaign id is given. A quest is an action inside a campaign that awards points; MANUAL quests are challenges the user announces, AUTOMATIC quests are triggered by platform events. Resolve a campaign id with list_campaigns.

campaign_id.description: Optional campaign (program) id to list only its quests.

limit.description: Maximum number of quests to return (default 10, max 50).

tools.name: get_quest
tools.title: Get a quest
tools.description: Get a single quest (a gamification action/rule) by its id, including its prerequisite quests. Resolve the quest id with list_quests.

tools.name: get_my_gamification_score
tools.title: Get my gamification score
tools.description: Get the current user's gamification score: the overall total points, the overall leaderboard rank and the points earned per campaign. Pass a campaign id to also get the user's rank and score within that campaign.

campaign_id.description: Optional campaign (program) id to scope the rank and score to that campaign.

tools.name: get_gamification_leaderboard
tools.title: Get the gamification leaderboard
tools.description: Get the gamification leaderboard (top earners ranked by points), optionally scoped to a campaign and/or a space, for a given period. Resolve a campaign id with list_campaigns and a space id with get_my_spaces.

campaign_id.description: Optional campaign (program) id to scope the leaderboard.

space_id.description: Optional space id to scope the leaderboard.

identity_type.description: Whether to rank users or spaces (default USER).

limit.description: Maximum number of leaderboard rows to return (default 10, max 50).

tools.name: list_my_realizations
tools.title: List my realizations
tools.description: List the current user's own realizations (gamification achievements: points earned by completing quests). Optionally filter by date range (yyyy-MM-dd), campaign and/or status. This only ever returns the current user's own achievements.

from_date.description: Optional start date in yyyy-MM-dd format.

to_date.description: Optional end date in yyyy-MM-dd format.

campaign_id.description: Optional campaign (program) id to filter achievements.

limit.description: Maximum number of realizations to return (default 10, max 50).

tools.name: list_my_announcements
tools.title: List my quest announcements
tools.description: List the current user's own quest announcements (manual challenges they announced), most recent first, each with the announcement id needed to cancel it. Optionally pass a quest id to only list announcements for that quest. This only ever returns the current user's own announcements. Use this to find the announcement_id before calling cancel_quest_announcement.

quest_id.description: Optional quest (rule) id to only list announcements for that quest. Resolve it with list_quests.

limit.description: Maximum number of announcements to return (default 10, max 50).

tools.name: create_campaign
tools.title: Create a campaign
tools.description: Create a new campaign (a gamification program that groups quests). Requires rewarding-admin rights, or manager rights on the target space when a space id is given. Resolve a space id with get_my_spaces.

space_id.description: Optional space id the campaign belongs to. When set, the campaign defaults to RESTRICTED visibility for that space.

budget.description: Optional total points budget for the campaign.

open.description: Whether the campaign is open to everyone who can see it (default true).

visibility.description: Visibility of the campaign. Defaults to RESTRICTED when a space id is given, otherwise OPEN.

tools.name: create_quest
tools.title: Create a quest
tools.description: Create a new quest (a gamification action/rule) inside a campaign. Only MANUAL quests (challenges the user announces) are supported here; AUTOMATIC (event-triggered) quests are rejected. Requires being an owner of the campaign. Resolve the campaign id with list_campaigns.

campaign_id.description: Id of the campaign (program) the quest belongs to (required).

score.description: Points awarded when the quest is completed (required, positive).

type.description: Quest type. Defaults to MANUAL. AUTOMATIC is not supported via chat and will be rejected.

start_date.description: Optional start date in yyyy-MM-dd format.

end_date.description: Optional end date in yyyy-MM-dd format.

recurrence.description: Optional recurrence of the quest (default NONE).

tools.name: update_quest
tools.title: Update a quest
tools.description: Update an existing quest (a gamification action/rule). Only the fields you pass are changed; the others keep their current values. Requires being an owner of the quest's campaign. Resolve the quest id with list_quests.

quest_id.description: Technical id of the quest to update (required).

start_date.description: New start date in yyyy-MM-dd format (optional).

end_date.description: New end date in yyyy-MM-dd format (optional).

tools.name: delete_quest
tools.title: Delete a quest
tools.description: Delete a quest (a gamification action/rule). Requires being an owner of the quest's campaign. Resolve the quest id with list_quests.

quest_id.description: Technical id of the quest to delete (required).

tools.name: announce_quest
tools.title: Announce a quest
tools.description: Announce, as the current user, that they completed a manual quest (a challenge), so it can be reviewed and rewarded with points. Only MANUAL quests can be announced. Resolve the quest id with list_quests.

quest_id.description: Technical id of the manual quest (challenge) to announce (required).

comment.description: Optional comment describing what the user did.

tools.name: cancel_quest_announcement
tools.title: Cancel a quest announcement
tools.description: Cancel (delete) a quest announcement previously made by the current user. Only the author can cancel their own announcement. Find the announcement id with list_my_announcements.

announcement_id.description: Technical id of the announcement to cancel (required).
